name: SMS OTP Interception
description: Reads or forwards SMS one-time passwords to enable account takeover.

name: Overlay Phishing Attack
description: Uses an overlay capability with credential-capture behaviour to imitate a banking screen.

name: Accessibility Service Abuse
description: Abuses accessibility capabilities to read content or automate actions without informed user intent.

name: Dynamic Code Loading
description: Loads secondary DEX or native payloads at runtime to evade static inspection.

name: Device Admin Persistence
description: Requests device-admin capabilities to resist removal or control device state.

name: Package Installation Abuse
description: Requests package-install capabilities for secondary payload delivery.

name: Call Forwarding or Vishing Support
description: Uses telephony capabilities in support of call interception or social engineering.

name: Self-Signed Repackaging
description: Repackages a legitimate application and distributes a differently signed APK.

name: Heavy Obfuscation or Packing
description: Uses obfuscation or packing that materially raises the cost of code inspection.

name: Fake KYC or Onboarding Flow
description: Uses a counterfeit onboarding flow to collect identity or payment information.
